impl LaneDrainForTheStrip {
    fn drain_controls_for_lane(&mut self, control: &mut Consumer<Record>, kind: Kind) {
        for _ in 0..self
            .control_lane_consumer_for_this_strip_with_a_long_name
            .available_at_entry()
        {
            let Ok(record) = self
                .control_lane_consumer_for_this_strip_with_a_long_name
                .try_pop()
            else {
                break;
            };
            self.apply(record);
        }
    }
}
